blocks.text: KAUSWAGAN, Lanao del Norte – Kauswagan, once a war-torn town in Lanao del Norte, is gearing up for the impact of the “super” El Niño with a P30-million solar power facility, set to run in the next few weeks. Vice Mayor Rommel Arnado said they have intensified preparations for the projected super El Niño expected to hit the country late in 2026 and to persist until early 2027. He said the town’s preparations include cushioning impacts of a severe drought on local government operations, agriculture, food security, and water supplies, among others.
